title: у + genitive: near, at, by (also shows possession)

blocks.text: **у** takes the **genitive** case: near, at, by (also shows possession).

items: in the possession of (used to express "to have")
belonging to (used to denote ownership of body parts or appendages of objects)
How much time do you have?
